arguments.summary: Investigated the root cause of the p99 latency spike, identified it as a pgbouncer connection pool refresh issue. Also, checked the failed-jobs backlog and found 47 malformed rows blocking the retry queue. These rows were deleted, unblocking the queue.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Monitor the failed-jobs queue and ensure that the jobs are not generating malformed rows in the future. Also, consider reviewing the job processing logic to prevent such issues.
